565 is a fresh measurement of the rebased tree with this gate's own --count, not arithmetic on the two notes. The superseded note from this branch follows.

--- SUPERSEDED NOTE FROM THIS BRANCH:

1644 -> 565: odoo/orm reaches zero on this gate -- 1079 excess lines over 30 functions, all of it.

CORRECTING THE BASE, NOT THE DELTA. The previous commit banked 589, which is
1668 - 1079: a correct delta against a base that had already moved. ec0eb2bd776
stripped every Python comment and docstring from odoo/ between the measurement
and the commit, taking the control 1668 -> 1644, and 24 of those excess lines
were prose in odoo/upgrade_code. 1644 - 1079 = 565, which is what the tree
measures at its own commit. The -1079 was never wrong; the base was, for the
second time in this change. Verify at your OWN sha after committing, not at the
tree you built from -- checking before the commit is what missed it here.

Eighteen of the thirty were also c901 offenders and are listed in that floor's
note. The twelve that were long without being complex:

  models/mixins/translation.py       _update_field_translations  +80  two whole algorithms behind one if
  models/mixins/load.py              _extract_records            +46  its two itemgetter blocks were De Morgan duplicates
  models/mixins/unlink.py            _delete_sql                 +45  three independent company-dependent guards
  fields/base.py                     _get_cache_miss             +41  five branches each rebinding one 'value'
  fields/properties.py               _validate_properties_definition +35 three unrelated rule families in one loop body
  models/mixins/read_group/sql.py    _read_group_groupby_properties  +34 one branch per property type, and the
                                                                          comodel guard was written twice
  runtime/_registry_schema.py        check_indexes               +31  expression building interleaved with DDL
  fields/properties.py               condition_to_sql            +29  the in/not-in branch is half the method
  models/mixins/read_group/sql.py    _read_group_groupby         +24  two relational join builders
  models/mixins/read_group/format.py _read_group_format_result   +17  the temporal label/range builder
  models/mixins/read_group/sql.py    _read_group_orderby         +13  many2one traversal and day-of-week offset
  runtime/registry.py                new                         +10  the finalize phase

WHAT WAS NOT DONE FOR THE NUMBER. The hot read path is split per FIELD, never
per record: _read_format's four helpers are each called once for a field and
loop over records inside, so a 10,000-record read pays four extra Python calls,
not forty thousand.
